card.fact_statement: The second round of the 2025 Polish presidential election was held on 1 June 2025.
card.source_span: As no candidate received a majority of the vote, a second round was held on 1 June 2025.

target_qa_variants.question: 2025年ポーランド大統領選挙の第2回投票はいつ行われましたか？
target_qa_variants.source_span: As no candidate received a majority of the vote, a second round was held on 1 June 2025.
target_qa_variants.translation_note: Translated 'second round' as 第2回投票. The English aliases '1 June 2025' and 'June 1, 2025' both translate to the same standard Japanese date format (2025年6月1日), so a common numeric format (2025/6/1) was provided as an alias.

backtranslation_en.question: When was the second round of voting for the 2025 Polish presidential election held?

backtranslation_consistency.reason: The target language QA accurately translates the source question and expected answer, preserving the exact same fact without adding new constraints.
